title: La reconnaissance de paternité  (The Paternity Recognition)

segments.t: Camille arrives at Mathias's apartment to discuss her lost book contract and share an unexpected decision. She tells Mathias that she is finally ready to accept official paternity recognition. Let's listen to their emotional conversation in French first.
Bonjour Camille! Comment tu vas?
Ça va. Noémie n'est pas là?
Non. Qu'est-ce qui se passe?
J'ai des problèmes au travail.
J'ai perdu mon premier grand contrat.
Ne t'inquiète pas, d'autres contrats viendront.
Mais je voulais te parler d'autre chose.
J'ai réfléchi à la reconnaissance de paternité.
Vraiment? Qu'est-ce qui t'a fait changer d'avis?
Je veux le faire, on se ressemble.
On peut aller à la mairie demain!
On peut télécharger le formulaire maintenant?
Tu as raison, assieds-toi à mon bureau!
On trinque? Je vais chercher à boire!
Let's examine the conversation line by line and explore the French expressions.
Bonjour Camille! Comment tu vas?
'Hello Camille! How are you doing?' Mathias welcomes his daughter into his apartment.
Ça va. Noémie n'est pas là?
'I am fine. Is Noemie not here?' Camille checks whether Mathias is currently alone.
Non. Qu'est-ce qui se passe?
'No. What is going on?' Mathias wonders what brings Camille to his home so unexpectedly.
J'ai des problèmes au travail.
'I am having problems at work.' Camille mentions that things have gone wrong at the agency.
J'ai perdu mon premier grand contrat.
'I lost my first big contract.' Camille explains the loss of her promising book adaptation.
Ne t'inquiète pas, d'autres contrats viendront.
'Do not worry, other contracts will come.' Mathias tries to comfort her with professional optimism.
Mais je voulais te parler d'autre chose.
'But I wanted to talk to you about something else.' Camille steers the conversation toward a personal matter.
J'ai réfléchi à la reconnaissance de paternité.
'I thought about the paternity recognition.' Camille announces her willingness to make their bond official.
Vraiment? Qu'est-ce qui t'a fait changer d'avis?
'Really? What made you change your mind?' Mathias is pleasantly surprised by her change of heart.
Je veux le faire, on se ressemble.
'I want to do it, we resemble each other.' Camille notes their shared traits and personality.
On peut aller à la mairie demain!
'We can go to town hall tomorrow!' Mathias eagerly suggests making the declaration immediately.
On peut télécharger le formulaire maintenant?
'Can we download the form now?' Camille suggests preparing the paperwork right away.
Tu as raison, assieds-toi à mon bureau!
'You are right, sit down at my desk!' Mathias invites her to use his personal computer.
On trinque? Je vais chercher à boire!
'Shall we drink to it? I will get something to drink!' Mathias heads to the kitchen to celebrate the moment. Now let's listen to the complete discussion once more to reinforce the vocabulary.

Deeply touched by Camille's decision, Mathias leads her to his computer and goes to fetch drinks. When you watch the episode, listen out for the expressions meaning 'is going on' and 'problems'. You'll catch them now. See you next time!
Bonne journée!
